title: 第11章 小队成员＋3第12章 遭遇丧尸20
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
顺便查看了一下技能。
技能：【鉴定】【采集】
【基础剑术（lv.1）：基础的剑招，刺、劈、撩、挂、云、点、崩、截。
「永恒领域」的这种能量算得上是“万精油”
，类似于一种初始能量，可以转化为自己所需要的功法能量。
按照《基础五行诀》上的记载，修炼时需要的是灵气。
前世，苏墨修炼武道时，这种能量可以转化为补充肉身的血气；修炼魔法时，可以转化为魔力。
赵敢当与其余三人也陆续起来了，根本不用提醒。
在外露天睡觉，白天的太阳都可以把人亮醒，更别说在「永恒领域」，太阳只比以前更强。
“早啊，苏兄。”
赵敢当走过来，伸了一个懒腰，看向苏墨。
“苏兄，你，你好像变得更帅了，嘿嘿。”
“别在这里献殷勤了。”
苏墨说道。
苏墨已经步入超凡，看着自然与常人有着明显的区别。
每个人不同的职业与功法所给人带来的感觉是截然不同的，比如自然属性的魔法师给人的感觉就很舒服；霸道猛烈的武功就显得很阳刚；还有欺诈者会让人不自主的放下戒心，当然这也有能力的作用。
苏墨此时看起来就比较潇洒出尘，面貌也更白皙了一些。
赵敢当这憨货脑子里哪有什么新鲜的词汇，他只是觉得苏墨变帅了。
“没啊，俺才没有献殷勤，苏婷姐，你看苏兄是不是变得更帅了。”
“让我看看。”

严梅先嚷嚷着跳了出来。
一副姣好的容貌出现在苏墨的视线中，脸上还残留着一些淡妆，只有嘴巴稍大了一些。
“说不上来，无论怎么看都是和昨天一样，但怎么说呢，好像是看着更顺眼了。”
严梅看了一会也没说出个所以然来，把苏婷拉了过来让她看看。
苏婷看了一眼就说：“气质，气质好像突然转变了。”
其实苏婷没说全，之前的苏墨给人的感觉像一块冷冰冰的铁，现在却变得像一块温润的玉。
苏墨倒是没有在意这些事情，还在琢磨修仙的事，万事开头难，既然已经踏出去了第一步，后面的事情也变得简单了起来。
几人边聊天边吃东西恢复饱食度，中途赵敢当还拿出怪物肉出来烤：
【烤怪物肉：饱食度+18.7，精神值-10，生命值-3】
看到没有什么太大的消耗，赵敢当当即决定要吃了，苏墨也没阻止，看着赵敢当吃下去后，一脸便秘的模样，苏墨嘴角微扬，笑了一声。
前世别说烤熟了，就连生的怪物肉也吃过。
那时被仇家追杀，一路亡命奔逃，不敢生火煮熟，爆出的一些怪物肉只能选择生吃，幸好爆出的怪物肉里面没有一些寄生物，否则后续的恢复又要消耗掉一大笔钱。
苏墨只记得，怪物肉吃起来没有什么血腥味，咀嚼时能感受到肉的滑动，偶尔还有嚼不断的筋膜，也没有什么不适，一切都是为了生存罢了。
别说生肉了，一些小型庇护所没有种地，食物来源就两个——老鼠和蟑螂，吃不下去就等死，甚至还有以人为食的，念及于此，苏墨眼中闪过一丝冷芒。
苏墨选择制作了锤子，今天要离开这边地区，科学一本自然要敲走，顺便还解锁了一个铲子。
content_en:
Check out the skills by the way.
Skills: [Appraisal] [Collection]
[Basic swordsmanship (lv.1): Basic sword moves, stabbing, splitting, teasing, hanging, cloud, point, collapse, and interception.
This energy in the "Eternal Realm" can be regarded as the "Ten Thousand Essential Oils"
, similar to a kind of initial energy, which can be converted into the energy of the skills you need.
According to the records in "Basic Five Elements Jue", spiritual energy is needed for practice.
In his previous life, when Su Mo practiced martial arts, this energy could be converted into blood that replenished the physical body; when practicing magic, it could be converted into magic power.
Zhao Gandang and the other three people also got up one after another without any need to be reminded.
When sleeping outdoors, the sun can wake you up during the day, not to mention that in the "eternal realm", the sun is only stronger than before.
"Good morning, Brother Su."
Zhao Gandang came over, stretched and looked at Su Mo.
"Brother Su, you, you seem to have become more handsome, hehe."
"Stop being so ingratiating here."
Su Mo said.
Su Mo has entered the transcendent world, and there is a clear difference between nature and ordinary people.
Each person's different occupations and skills give people completely different feelings. For example, a magician with natural attributes makes people feel very comfortable; a domineering and fierce martial arts appears very masculine; and a deceiver makes people involuntarily let down their guard. Of course, this also has the effect of ability.
Su Mo looked more chic and fairer now.
Zhao Gandang didn't think this idiot had any new words in his mind. He just thought Su Mo had become more handsome.
"No, I'm not being attentive. Sister Su Ting, look at Brother Su, has he become more handsome?"
"Let me see."
Yan Mei jumped out shouting first.
A beautiful appearance appeared in Su Mo's sight. There was still some light makeup on her face, only her mouth was slightly bigger.
"I can't tell you. No matter how you look at it, it's the same as yesterday, but it seems to be more pleasing to the eye."
Yan Mei looked at it for a while without saying anything, so she pulled Su Ting over and let her have a look.
Su Ting took one look and said, "Temperament, temperament seems to have suddenly changed."
In fact, Su Ting didn't tell the whole story. Su Mo used to feel like a piece of cold iron, but now he feels like a piece of warm jade.
Su Mo didn't pay attention to these things, and was still thinking about cultivating immortality. Everything was difficult at the beginning, but now that he had taken the first step, the rest became easier.
Several people chatted and ate to restore their satiety. In the middle of the process, Zhao Gandang took out monster meat and grilled it:
[Grilled monster meat: satiety +18.7, mental value -10, health value -3]
Seeing that there was no big consumption, Zhao Gandang immediately decided to eat, and Su Mo didn't stop him. Seeing that Zhao Gandang looked constipated after eating, Su Mo raised the corner of his mouth and smiled.
In the previous life, let alone roasting it, I even ate raw monster meat.
At that time, I was chased by my enemies and ran away all the way. I didn't dare to light a fire and cook it. Some of the monster meat that was exploded had to be eaten raw. Fortunately, there were no parasites in the monster meat. Otherwise, the subsequent recovery would cost a lot of money.
Su Mo only remembered that there was no bloody smell when eating monster meat. When chewing, you could feel the sliding of the meat. Occasionally, there was chewing fascia. There was no discomfort. Everything was just for survival.
Not to mention raw meat, some small shelters have no land, and there are only two sources of food - rats and cockroaches. If you can't eat them, you will die, and some even feed on humans. Thinking of this, a cold light flashed in Su Mo's eyes.
Su Mo chose to make a hammer. He was leaving this area today, so he naturally had to knock away the science book. By the way, he also unlocked a shovel.
